angles_scanned: arxiv: PEAD + post-earnings drift + text signals
method: 5 parallel research agents, one per angle, each doing WebSearch + WebFetch and grep-checking the existing wiki before treating a finding as new

findings.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep RL
findings.reason_not_staged: Only hit 10% significance via circular block bootstrap (missed 5% threshold); crypto-only universe. Filter-then-Rank selection stage is conceptually interesting but weak evidence.

findings.title: Pairs Trading — Selection via Scoring Systems
findings.reason_not_staged: No numbers disclosed in open abstract; paywalled; conceptually overlaps with already-exhausted H200 pairs-trading line.

findings.title: Statistical Arbitrage in Polish Equities Market Using Deep Learning
findings.reason_not_staged: Non-US market, dated regime data (2017-2020), small OOS sample not comparable to our gate criteria.

findings.title: From Hypotheses to Factors: Constrained LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency Markets
findings.reason_not_staged: Not pairs-specific; LLM hypothesis-search meta-agent framework, tangentially adjacent to H318 (already in wiki, not re-staged).

findings.title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis via Market-Aligned RL
Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
findings.caveat: Paywalled beyond abstract; full methodology unverified

findings.title: Effective Performance Measurement: KPI Extraction from Earnings Calls
findings.reason_not_staged: Transcript-focused, same coverage-bias problem H168 already identified; no numbers in abstract

findings.title: The Informational Role of the Most Recent Month in Industry-Level Momentum Strategies
findings.caveat: Zenodo preprint, not peer-reviewed or arXiv; staged as medium-risk new_script stub requiring manual build-out, not auto-apply

findings.title: Measuring Strategy-Decay Risk: Minimum Regime Performance
Overreaction as an indicator for momentum (AAPL, sentiment features)
findings.reason_not_staged: Single-ticker, HFT-adjacent (10-min bars), requires social sentiment feed we don't have; not transferable to monthly-rebalance cross-sectional framework

findings.title: Regime-Dependent Predictive Structure Between Equity Factors
findings.reason_not_staged: Authors explicitly state findings do not yield trading profits; doesn't cover momentum specifically

findings.title: PolySwarm

summary.notable_pattern: Pairs/cointegration and multi-agent angles are heavily pre-scouted from prior dream cycle nights -- most hits were already ingested. PEAD and momentum angles each produced one genuinely new HIGH-relevance item plus one corroborating-but-paywalled high-pedigree item (Koijen/Levy). GitHub scan's one clean win (cvxportfolio) fills a real gap: none of the existing portfolio-optimization tools (PyPortfolioOpt/Riskfolio-Lib/skfolio) combine convex optimization with a cost-aware backtest loop.
